<P STYLE="margin: 0; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>NRG Energy Announces
Leadership Succession Plan</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><I>Robert J. Gaudette,
EVP, President of NRG Business and Wholesale Operations, Named President; To Become Chief Executive Officer Effective as of NRG&rsquo;s
2026 Annual Shareholder Meeting</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>HOUSTON&mdash;January&nbsp;07, 2026</B>&mdash;NRG
Energy,&nbsp;Inc. (NYSE: NRG) today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Robert J. Gaudette, Executive Vice President,
President of NRG Business and Wholesale Operations, as Chief Executive Officer, effective April&nbsp;30, 2026, the date of the Company&rsquo;s
2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. In connection with his appointment as CEO, the Board has named Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette President of NRG,
effective today. The Board also plans to nominate Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette for election to the Board at the 2026 Annual Meeting.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">As part of a planned succession, Lawrence
Coben, Ph.D., will step down as President today and will remain as Chair and CEO until April&nbsp;30, 2026. He will serve as an advisor
to the company for the remainder of 2026. In addition, NRG&rsquo;s Board has appointed Antonio Carrillo, Lead Independent Director, as
Chair, effective April&nbsp;30, 2026.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&ldquo;Serving as CEO of NRG has been
a great privilege and highlight of my career. I am grateful to have worked alongside NRG&rsquo;s talented team during this exciting time
for our industry and am proud of all that we have accomplished together,&rdquo; said Dr.&nbsp;Coben.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Dr.&nbsp;Coben continued, &ldquo;Rob
has played a central role in strengthening NRG&rsquo;s position as a leader in our industry through strategic growth, operational excellence,
and customer-focused innovation. He is a strong, decisive leader with extensive knowledge of our business, markets, and customers. The
Board and I are confident that Rob is the right person to lead NRG forward and take the NRG rocket ship to new heights. I can&rsquo;t
wait to see what comes next.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In his current role, Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette
manages one of the largest business-to-business retail gas, power and demand response platforms in North America. He oversees NRG&rsquo;s
broad portfolio of commercial and industrial products and services as well as its market operations, including gas and power trading,
origination, commercial analytics, and real-time operations. He also leads all of NRG&rsquo;s power generation, including plant operations,
asset management, development, engineering, and procurement. Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette joined NRG in 2001 from a predecessor company and has
progressed over his 25 years with the company through numerous positions of increasing responsibility.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&ldquo;It is an honor to be appointed
NRG&rsquo;s next CEO at this transformative time for the energy sector and our company,&rdquo; said Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette. &ldquo;With NRG&rsquo;s
electricity, natural gas and smart home portfolio, we are ideally positioned to meet America&rsquo;s evolving energy needs. I am grateful
to Larry and all my NRG colleagues, both past and present, who built our great company and positioned us for the future. I look forward
to leading our incredible team to deliver affordable, resilient power for the customers and communities we serve, while creating substantial
value for our shareholders.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&ldquo;The Board sincerely thanks Larry
for his leadership, strategic vision, and guidance during his time at NRG. Under his stewardship, NRG achieved excellent operational
and financial performance. His many contributions to the Company will be felt for years to come,&rdquo; said Mr.&nbsp;Carrillo. &ldquo;Rob
is a proven leader with an exceptional track record who is deeply respected within NRG and across the energy sector. We know he will
lead NRG to continued success.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>About Robert J. Gaudette</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette has served as Executive
Vice President of NRG Business and Market Operations since 2022 and President of NRG Business and Market Operations since 2024. He served
as Senior Vice President, Business Solutions from 2013 to 2022, leading the largest business-to-business retail gas and power platform
in North America. Prior to 2013, Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette held several executive positions at NRG. He joined NRG in 2001 from a predecessor
company and has progressed over his 25 years with the company through numerous positions spanning trading, asset management, government
and regulatory affairs, finance, strategy, sales, origination, customer care, and product development.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette earned a Bachelor
of Science degree in chemistry from The College of William and Mary and a Master of Business Administration from Rice University, where
he was a Jones Scholar.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Mr.&nbsp;Gaudette served four years
as an Army officer, including a one-year deployment to Bosnia with the Second Armored Cavalry Regiment.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>About NRG</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">NRG Energy,&nbsp;Inc.&nbsp;is leading
the future of energy&mdash;now. Our solutions power a smarter, brighter future by helping customers achieve today's goals while solving
for the challenges of tomorrow. Every day, we deliver innovative natural gas, electricity, and smart home solutions to customers large
and small across&nbsp;North America. Visit&nbsp;<U>nrg.com</U>&nbsp;for more information, and connect with us on <U>Facebook</U>,&nbsp;<U>Instagram</U>,
<U>LinkedIn</U>, and&nbsp;<U>X</U>.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
